delayed.label: Capability milestone slips beyond 2029
delayed.review_signal: Reliability, research judgment or adoption stalls; conventional businesses keep growing.
delayed.story: Existing AI growth continues; transformative deployment contributes nothing within five years.

efficient.label: AGI arrives; efficiency wins
efficient.review_signal: Useful workloads expand while rental pricing, hardware orders and supplier margins weaken.
efficient.story: Work grows fast, but compute per workload falls faster; platforms capture more than equipment.

measured.label: 2028–29 breakthrough, measured adoption
measured.review_signal: Multiday reliability improves; paid deployment and cash conversion rise gradually.
measured.story: Our central timing case: useful adoption takes longer than capability.

overbuild.label: Early AGI, financing and overbuild stress
overbuild.review_signal: Unprofitable capacity, cancellations, refinancing or dilution persist despite capability progress.
overbuild.story: Capabilities arrive early; funding, weak utilization and repricing overwhelm equipment growth.

rapid.label: Early breakthrough, durable profits
rapid.review_signal: Validated autonomous research, paid renewals and cash margins accelerate together.
rapid.story: Rapid adoption and scarce capacity support supplier profits.

capability_definition: Scenario milestone: AI can autonomously complete a broad range of economically valuable multiday cognitive and AI-research tasks at dependable reliability. A modeling convention, not a claim of observed AGI or a universal definition.
dividend_policy: No separately modeled dividends or reinvestment; price-only economic bridge

accelerators.note: Competitive accelerators; pricing, architectures and foundry capacity can change capture.

broad_fund.note: Whole-fund aggregate earnings proxy, including non-tech sectors.

consumer.note: Consumer ecosystem; modest AI monetization sensitivity.

custom_network.note: Custom silicon and interconnect; communication intensity and substitutions matter.

foundry.note: Manufacturing across architectures; capital intensity and geopolitics remain.

hbm.note: HBM/DRAM cycle; no guaranteed shortage rent.

nand.note: NAND/storage demand is distinct from HBM.

nasdaq_funds.note: Whole-fund aggregate earnings proxy, not constituent look-through.

non_ai.note: Bank and pharmaceutical exposures are not treated as AI equipment demand.

operators.note: Cash-conversion haircut includes interest and replacement capex; explicit new-share dilution.

platforms.note: Existing businesses plus paid AI adoption; capex and cannibalization can offset revenue.

power_cooling.note: Physical delivery, backlog conversion and cash margins constrain gains.

software.note: Software/data demand; competition and valuation matter.

speculative.note: Robotics/launch businesses: weak direct link to digital workloads; large independent risks.

limitations: Normalized economic sensitivities, not completed issuer DCFs or verified earnings forecasts. All numerical operating, multiple and weight assumptions are analyst judgments.
Current absolute issuer earnings/FCF, net debt, segment exposure and justified exit multiples are incomplete. Today’s market price anchors the normalized base and may already be expensive.
Five illustrative branches are not an exhaustive set of real outcomes; deterministic endpoints omit within-branch market risk, default tails, catastrophic outcomes and policy surprises.
Scenario endpoint min/max is not a confidence interval. Weighted endpoints are not medians; endpoint weight shares are not calibrated loss/doubling probabilities.
Historical market model remains separate. Its returns and probabilities are not added to, multiplied by, or relabeled as AGI forecasts.
Price-only scenarios assume no separate dividend cash or reinvestment, unlike the historical total-return baseline. Differences therefore include method and income policy, not just AGI.
No deposits, withdrawals, trading, rebalancing, option rolls or swing alpha. Recorded stocks/ETFs only; options, cash, bonds, borrowing, taxes and inflation excluded.

GOOG/GOOGL use identical economic factors; QQQ/QQQM use identical fund factors. No unverified fund look-through. Broad category settings obscure issuer differences; speculative holdings have substantial non-AI risk.
A deterministic endpoint below today does not measure interim drawdown or the real probability of loss. Do not size or trade from these weights.

uncertainty_type: Subjective scenario weights; deterministic endpoints, no within-branch market distribution or calibrated event probabilities
weight_origin: Provisional analyst judgment for a thesis-testing exercise. Not user-approved personal probabilities, empirically estimated frequencies, Anthropic probabilities, or an investment recommendation. Rounded weights are deliberately easy to challenge.
weight_rationale: Four branches place the capability milestone inside the user’s 2027–2029 scenario window, but differ in adoption and shareholder capture. The measured branch has the largest working weight. Early profitable acceleration gets less weight than measured adoption; efficiency, overbuild and delay retain explicit material weights. There is no statistical evidence establishing these exact percentages.
